audience: ambulatory physician practices and medical groups
reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: We choose the ambulatory EHR that demonstrably fits our clinical and billing workflows, meets compliance and interoperability needs, and can be reliably supported at a sustainable total cost.

scenarios.label: Multi-site consolidation
scenarios.description: A large multi-site medical group standardizes on one ambulatory EHR across locations, prioritizing interoperability, governance, and phased migration.

scenarios.label: Mid-group RFP
scenarios.description: A 20 - 100 provider independent group runs a formal RFP with deep demos and references to replace or upgrade its ambulatory EHR and PM.

scenarios.label: Specialty clinic needs
scenarios.description: A specialty practice selects an EHR for procedure-specific templates, device/imaging integration, and specialty reporting requirements.

scenarios.label: Small practice pick
scenarios.description: A 1 - 5 provider office chooses an all-in-one ambulatory EHR/PM they can run with minimal IT and fast onboarding.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Multi-site consolidation|generic] we're rolling up 7 outpatient clinics into one group. charts are scattered, schedules don't sync, referrals fall through, and billing rules differ site to site. patients think we lost their history. how do groups fix this without wrecking day to day?

[problem_recognition|Mid-group RFP|generic] mid-sized group, about 45 providers. leadership wants standardized documentation and one set of reports for payers and quality programs. right now IT is stitching interfaces and CSVs every week and it's brittle. what's the sane path here?

[problem_recognition|Specialty clinic needs|generic] we're an ortho clinic with an ASC. op notes need laterality, implants, and images tied in, and prior auth is constant. our current setup makes us enter the same data in three places and it still misses details. how do ortho groups streamline this?

[problem_recognition|Small practice pick|generic] 2-doctor family practice. scheduling in a shared calendar, labs by fax, refills by phone, notes in a clunky template I made years ago. i'm trying to get us organized without blowing the budget. what should I be aiming for first?
[category_education|-|generic] what does an ambulatory EHR actually do for an outpatient clinic? beyond charting, does it handle scheduling, billing, reporting, and patient messaging too?

[discovery|Multi-site consolidation|generic] best ambulatory EHR for consolidating 10 clinics into one organization? need shared charts, centralized scheduling, strong data migration support, and solid enterprise reporting.
[discovery|Mid-group RFP|generic] for a 60-provider multi-specialty group going out to RFP, what are the best ambulatory EHR options to evaluate, and what criteria should be non-negotiable?
[discovery|Specialty clinic needs|generic] best ambulatory EHR for pediatrics - vaccine inventory, growth charts, age-based templates, parent proxies, school forms. who actually does peds well?

[discovery|Small practice pick|generic] looking for the best ambulatory EHR for a 3-provider primary care office. cloud-based, reasonable cost, straightforward scheduling, clean labs and prescribing, built-in telehealth. which ones fit a small practice that decides by specs?

[shortlist|Multi-site consolidation|generic] shortlist 4 or 5 ambulatory EHRs that handle multi-site consolidation well - centralized scheduling, role-based access, reliable data migration, governance tools.

[shortlist|Mid-group RFP|generic] need a shortlist of ambulatory EHRs for about 50 physicians across several locations, with integrated clinical and billing, robust analytics, and strong implementation support. 5 max.
[shortlist|Specialty clinic needs|generic] cardiology clinic with heavy imaging and procedures - can you give me a shortlist of 4 ambulatory EHR options that fit cardio workflows and registries?
[shortlist|Small practice pick|generic] for a 2-3 provider family medicine office, narrow it to 3 or 4 ambulatory EHRs that are cloud, easy to learn, and won't crush us on cost.

[criteria|Multi-site consolidation|generic] we're rolling up 7 outpatient clinics under one medical group and need to pick a single EHR/PM. what should we actually prioritize for multi-site consolidation so it doesn't blow up later? help me rank what matters most (data migration, multi-location scheduling, permissions, centralized reporting, uptime, change management, etc.).

[criteria|Mid-group RFP|generic] writing an RFP for a mid-sized ambulatory group, about 80 providers. what selection criteria really move the needle and are straightforward to verify in demos and contracts? want must-haves, not fluff.

[criteria|Specialty clinic needs|generic] multi-specialty outpatient (cardio, GI, pulm). choosing one EHR that won't fight subspecialty workflows. what should we require around device integrations, procedure documentation, registries, prior auth, and team-based care? any gotchas folks forget?

[criteria|Small practice pick|generic] 2-doc internal med startup, tight budget. i want a spec-based checklist to choose an EHR/PM: clinical essentials, eRx/EPCS, labs, patient portal, scheduling, rev cycle, reporting, data export, security, support SLAs, total cost. how do we evaluate cleanly and compare apples to apples?

[feature_screening|Multi-site consolidation|generic] which ambulatory EHRs support a single patient record across multiple sites with an enterprise MPI and true cross-location scheduling out of the box?

[feature_screening|Mid-group RFP|generic] for a mid-sized group, which platforms have native revenue cycle capabilities built in (claim scrubbing, ERA auto-posting, denial workflows) rather than relying on add-on vendors?

[feature_screening|Specialty clinic needs|generic] for ophthalmology clinics, which systems offer real imaging integration (OCT and fundus), procedure note templates, and discrete outcomes capture without custom builds?

[feature_screening|Small practice pick|generic] which cloud EHRs let a small practice self-serve a complete, real-time export of all data (patients, notes, labs, CCDs) without paying for a custom services project?

[use_case|Multi-site consolidation|generic] we're merging data from four different EHRs into one and want zero downtime. how would you handle patient deduping, mapping codes and orderables, and staged go-lives so front desk and clinicians aren't stuck during cutover?

[use_case|Mid-group RFP|generic] use case for the RFP: pre-visit planning that moves work off the physician. can you outline an end-to-end workflow in the EHR/PM (scheduling cues, eligibility, gaps in care, orders queued, note templates preloaded) and how we'd measure throughput gains?

[use_case|Specialty clinic needs|generic] ortho clinic scenario: new patient with knee pain, same-day imaging, injection procedure, and referral to PT. how should the EHR handle templated HPI/ROS, imaging orders/results, procedure documentation with lot tracking, and prior auth in one flow?

[use_case|Small practice pick|generic] 2-provider family med starting fresh. target is average charting time under 8 minutes and a sane inbox. what specific EHR configuration and team workflow (templates, order sets, task routing, in-visit labs) gets us there without adding headcount?

[social_validation|-|generic] for independent ambulatory practices, which EHRs are actually well rated by peers right now? where can I find credible, detailed reviews or physician forums, and any recent satisfaction surveys focused on outpatient settings?

[comparison|Multi-site consolidation|Epic] We're consolidating 12 outpatient sites onto one platform. athenahealth vs Epic - which handles centralized scheduling, shared records, and rev cycle across locations with less pain? What blows up in migration?

[comparison|Mid-group RFP|Oracle Cerner] 80-provider group, RFP down to athenahealth and Oracle Cerner. For ambulatory, which gives smoother clinician workflows and stronger RCM, and how do implementation timelines and 5-year costs compare?

[comparison|Specialty clinic needs|Allscripts] Specialty clinic - ortho and sports med with imaging, injections, procedures. athenahealth or Allscripts: which handles templates, PACS integration, prior auth, and device data without a ton of custom work?

[comparison|Small practice pick|eClinicalWorks] 2-doctor family practice choosing between athenahealth and eClinicalWorks. I care about speed on average PCs, easy note template tweaks, clean claims day one, and being able to export all data if we switch. Which would you pick and why?

[objections|Multi-site consolidation|generic] Honest take - does athenahealth slow down when multiple sites hit it at once? We run 15 clinics and mornings are slammed. Any real uptime and latency numbers?
[objections|Mid-group RFP|generic] Our docs hate spinner wheels. Is athenahealth snappy chart to chart, or are we waiting 3-5 seconds per screen? Looking for peak-hour performance, not lab demos.
[objections|Specialty clinic needs|generic] We attach big imaging files and long op notes. Does athenahealth bog down opening those charts or during eRx? I cannot have lag mid-procedure.

[objections|Small practice pick|generic] Convince me athenahealth performance is fine on a small practice setup. On 50 Mbps down and older i5 desktops, what are typical load times for chart open, med search, order entry? Numbers please.

[pricing|Multi-site consolidation|generic] Ballpark total cost to move 10-20 sites onto one ambulatory EHR - per provider fees, interfaces to labs and HIE, data conversion, training. What do groups actually pay over 5 years per provider?
[pricing|Mid-group RFP|generic] What does athenahealth usually charge per provider for EHR plus RCM in a 70-100 provider group? Any volume discounts, and what add-ons tend to surprise people?

[pricing|Specialty clinic needs|generic] For a procedure-heavy specialty clinic, do ambulatory EHRs price higher than primary care? Extra fees for controlled substance eRx, registries, prior auth tools, or imaging interfaces?

[pricing|Small practice pick|generic] 2-provider startup - what would athenahealth cost all-in per month for EHR, eRx, portal, telehealth, and claims clearinghouse? Contract length, onboarding fees, and any exit costs to get our data out?

[business_case|Multi-site consolidation|generic] Consolidating 9 outpatient clinics into one group. I'm proposing athenahealth to standardize EHR and billing. Can you help me build the CFO case: switching costs, where we save real money, and first year cash impact?
[business_case|Mid-group RFP|generic] We're mid RFP for a 40 provider group. If we pick athenahealth, how do I make the case to our CFO on total cost vs staying put, and what the payback looks like?

[business_case|Specialty clinic needs|generic] We run a multi-site ortho and sports med practice with an ASC. Looking at athenahealth. I need a CFO-ready case centered on prior auths, surgical scheduling, and denials. What assumptions and metrics should I bring?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] We've been on athenahealth for 5 years. Denials are creeping up and docs gripe about clicks. How do I decide if we double down and fix settings or start evaluating other EHRs?
[alternatives|-|defensive] If we move off athenahealth, what ambulatory EHRs should we shortlist for a 60 provider multi-specialty group with heavy RCM complexity?
[alternatives|-|Epic] Not loving Epic for our independent clinics. What are good ambulatory EHR alternatives that aren't tied to a hospital network?
[alternatives|-|Oracle Cerner] Looking to get off Oracle Cerner in a 25 provider outpatient group. What alternatives fit ambulatory well with solid scheduling and integrated RCM?
[alternatives|-|Allscripts] We're on Allscripts in our clinics. What are the better replacement options for ambulatory groups right now?
[alternatives|-|eClinicalWorks] eClinicalWorks feels clunky for our workflows. Which other ambulatory EHRs are worth demoing for a 30 provider group?
[renewal|-|generic] Renewal time with athenahealth. Is it worth keeping or are there cheaper options that won't mess up collections? Quick way to compare total cost and revenue impact?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] athenahealth claims aren't batching correctly to a couple payers after the last update. Where do I check payer mappings or clearinghouse settings, and how do I requeue just those without resubmitting the whole day?

[expansion|-|generic] We use athenahealth at our main site. Thinking about rolling it to two satellites and adding telehealth and digital intake. How do we phase it without killing throughput, and what training plan actually sticks?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What integrates cleanly with athenahealth for patient engagement and analytics? Looking for text reminders, online check in, referral management, and a simple BI tool my ops lead can run.

[advocacy|-|generic] i run a 9-provider family medicine practice on athenahealth. a partner clinic is on the fence. can you help me frame how to recommend it? i need a short email i can send and a quick talk track. they care about ambulatory stuff like schedule efficiency, clean claim rate, prior auth turnaround, portal engagement, MIPS reporting, and uptime. also want punchy replies to the usual pushbacks on training time, data migration risk, cost, and too many clicks. suggest a few concrete metrics i can pull from our own data to prove it.
